ccre.mechanism: Convert HSI and RGB into gray representations; maximize MI or CCRE under a six-parameter affine transform via analytic derivatives/Hessian and Newton optimization. MI uses Parzen cubic B-spline estimates of joint/marginal probabilities; CCRE substitutes cumulative residual distribution over transformed image intensity with cubic B-spline over reference intensity. Full explicit gradient/Hessian formulae delegated to cited work, not reproduced here.
ccre.grayConversionBoundary: Mean over bands/channels and CIE1931 conversion discussed as options; no controlled comparison or unambiguous final gray-conversion specification found. Do not write both as simultaneous implemented preprocessing or assume RGB fusion output.

ccre.results: Figure3 shows average maximum registration error per iteration for the second Figure1 image set, not pooled timing over all pairs. Both converge, CCRE curve earlier; abrupt drop at iteration200 accompanies scale change. Author prose says effectively100% success up to70px initial displacement and better than MI at larger displacement, SSD failed all cases. Curves not digitized into exact unsupported MAE/timing/success counts.
ccre.limits: No success threshold/error definition sufficient for independent reproduction, per-bin counts, timing/hardware, random seed, optimization stopping/boundary/interpolation parameters, confidence interval or real geometric GT obtained. Manual registration is the baseline for perturbation recovery, not independently surveyed physical truth. No demonstrated spectral/spatial fusion cube, non-affine registration, 3D, or across-scene generalization.

colour.mechanism: Dichromatic decomposition from cited method15;1-cos spectral affinity and maximum-entropy deterministic annealing build material clusters/Gibbs associations. Recover nonnegative sum-to-one endmember proportions per cluster, blend by pixel association. Per-endmember8-feature saturation/value descriptors feed Photo.net-trained QDA aesthetic score. Quasi-Newton optimizes user color residual plus τexp(-score), moderating HSV saturation/value without aesthetic hue features. Updated material/light RGB mappings render novel spectral imagery.

Photo.net-to-per-endmember-feature procedure, QDA covariance regularization, annealing cooling/split criteria, candidate matching/least-squares solver/tolerances, unobserved-range handling, and complete camera metadata unspecified. Eq4 is1-cos similarity complement, not literal arccos angle; numerical treatment of zero reflectance or feature denominators unknown.
